blocks.text: PERTH — A former Catholic bishop fond of hosting alcohol-fueled, shirtless parties will spend at least four and a half years behind bars for sexually abusing two young Aboriginal men. Former Bishop of Broome Christopher Alan Saunders, 76, was found guilty of 13 sex offenses following a jury trial in the West Australian District Court. The offenses, committed between 2010 and 2019, included one count of sexual penetration without consent and 12 counts of unlawful and indecent assault.
